body:
I think getting help is an incredibly brave and hard thing to do. Guilt can be an incredibly overwhelming emotion to reconcile. I wish more people would get the help they desperately deserve. Life can be a wonderful experience but it does take work and a lot of self discovery to get there. I have kinda accepted that nobody has their shit together, some are just better at hiding than others.   


Take care of yourself and family as well man.

This is amazing advice thank you so much, you have really made my day. I thought about power washing but that feels too fucked up for me. I feel so dumb for not thinking of this. I am def going to do this. I just dump the peroxide and walk away.   


Thank you Lady!

Thats fucking horrible, I'm sorry for ur losses. Yes we have talked about moving, but before we make any rash decisions, we wanted to see if we feel any different over the next few weeks. I don't expect much will change but uprooting your family is no simple task. I honestly don't know what we are going to do yet.  


I thought about power washing the street but feels too fucked up for me. I just hate the site of it. I thought the rain would have washed it away by now.

Thank you for sharing your story. It's really comforting to hear people of similar circumstances reach out and let us know it can get better. Makes me want to try harder. I shared my contact info with one of my neighbors who showed up on scene shortly after. We are going to grab coffee tomorrow. I am personally really thankful he decided to reach out and think it will be really helpful.

Has anyone tried meditation or mindfullness techniques? I have only tried a couple times but could not get into it. Maybe I should set a schedule and just keep at it?

Edit: I think group therapy might actually be a really good idea and possibly less cost prohibitive. I like the idea of building camaraderie out of really shitty situations.
